input.objective:
Audit the FLOP spend path of uxp-labs/flop-devnet-lab at this commit.
Scope: imd-flop/ (TypeScript CLI that lets an IMD worker pay FLOP for inference), spend-guard/ (Python), viewer/ (Python) and contract/ (shared rules and test vectors). Leave observatory/ and tclk-rehearsal/ out.
Work offline and read only: no network, no faucet, no keys, no paid calls. Do not run as root: one imd-flop test needs a read only file.
Run first: in imd-flop, npm ci then npm test (295 tests). In spend-guard and in viewer, python3 -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' (66 and 59 tests).
Look for:
1. Any path in imd-flop/src/run.ts, providers.ts or gateway.ts that mints a child key or sends a paid call after a local refusal, or after the run deadline.
2. Any receipt or refresh that lowers a booked charge or releases a reservation without a proven settlement (settlement.ts, ledger.ts, receipts.ts, contract/vectors).
3. Any way a key shaped value, a gateway bearer or the Ethereum RPC URL reaches the ledger, a receipt, a response file, stdout or stderr (secrets.ts, store.ts, gateway.ts).
4. Any case where imd-flop, spend-guard and the viewer disagree on a contract vector, or on how unknown spend is shown.
5. Whether findings 1 to 7 of the earlier audit are closed at this commit (its report: https://api.imd.fun/jobs/ba164ffa-1c3e-4183-93bd-4a11d24b76bd/report.md), and whether the refactor that moved the rules into shared modules (settlement.ts, policy.ts, receipt-store.ts) changed any refusal or booking decision.
For every finding give file and line, severity, impact and a reproduction that runs offline. Say which checks you ran and which you only read.
